Daily Routine.name: Find 3 new jobs
Daily Routine.sub: LinkedIn: search ANALYST AND HIRING, Data Scientist HIRING, ML Engineer OPEN. Also check Indeed, Glassdoor, Google Careers, Facebook groups.

Daily Routine.name: Check H1b sponsorship for each job
Daily Routine.sub: Go to h1bdata.info search company name. If no sponsorship history, skip it.

Daily Routine.name: Referral outreach 2 people
Daily Routine.sub: 80% of effort = referrals. DM 2 people who can refer you before applying cold. Use linkedin_referral template.

Daily Routine.name: Work yesterday's job pipeline
Daily Routine.sub: For each job from yesterday: find hiring manager, send DM, get HR email via hunter.io, send cold email, find peer for coffee chat.

Daily Routine.name: Rewrite resume + apply to 1 job
Daily Routine.sub: Only apply AFTER outreach is done. Use resume rewrite prompt. ATS check: 80%+ match. Then apply on LinkedIn/Indeed/company site.

Daily Routine.name: Post on LinkedIn
Daily Routine.sub: Share a project, insight, or learning. Once a week minimum. RAG chatbot post when ready.

Daily Routine.name: Update H1b company list
Daily Routine.sub: Add new companies from h1bdata.info, h1b employer database, your Google Drive PDFs (Chicago, Arizona, Dallas, Atlanta, NYC/NJ).

Daily Routine.name: Follow up on all pending outreach
Daily Routine.sub: Anyone you messaged 7 days ago with no reply send one polite follow-up.

Daily Routine.name: Message Peer
Daily Routine.sub: Hi [Name], I noticed you're a [role] at [Company] I'm exploring a similar role there and would love to hear about your experience. Would you be open to a 15-min virtual coffee chat? I'd really appreciate any insights. Thanks so much!

Per-Job Steps.name: Check h1bdata.info for sponsorship
Per-Job Steps.sub: Search company at h1bdata.info AND h1b employer database. No history = skip. Don't waste time.

Per-Job Steps.name: Find hiring manager on LinkedIn
Per-Job Steps.sub: Search: [Company] + [role title] + manager/lead/director. Note their name.

Per-Job Steps.name: Find HR email via hunter.io or LinkedIn
Per-Job Steps.sub: Go to hunter.io  enter company domain find HR/recruiter email. Or search LinkedIn: [Company] + recruiter/HR.

Per-Job Steps.name: Find peer in same role at company
Per-Job Steps.sub: LinkedIn: search [Company] + [Job Title]. Find someone 1 to 3 years in the role. Ask for coffee chat.

Per-Job Steps.name: DM hiring manager on LinkedIn
Per-Job Steps.sub: Send the DM before applying. Use dm_hiring_manager template. Keep it short 3 lines max.

Per-Job Steps.name: Cold email HR
Per-Job Steps.sub: Send cold email using template. Attach resume. Reference the role.

Per-Job Steps.name: Ask network for referral
Per-Job Steps.sub: Check: does anyone in your network work here? If yes  referral first, always. 80% rule.

Per-Job Steps.name: Rewrite resume for this job
Per-Job Steps.sub: Use the resume rewrite prompt. Paste job description. Get tailored resume. ATS check 80%+.

Per-Job Steps.name: Apply on LinkedIn / Indeed / company site
Per-Job Steps.sub: Apply LAST after outreach is done. With referral if possible. Note date applied.

H1b List.name: Pull list from h1bdata.info
H1b List.sub: Filter: Data Scientist / Analyst / ML Engineer. Year: 2023 to 2024. Min 10 approvals. Export.

H1b List.name: Pull list from H1b employer database
H1b List.sub: Cross-reference with h1bdata.info. Add any new companies.

H1b List.name: Check Google Drive PDFs
H1b List.sub: You have PDFs of H1b companies by city  Chicago, Arizona, Dallas, Atlanta, NYC/NJ. Go through each.

H1b List.name: Chicago companies
H1b List.sub: Closest to you. Priority 1. Find roles, verify H1b, add to pipeline.

H1b List.name: Atlanta companies
H1b List.sub: Home Depot, NCR, Cox  good H1b history. Priority 4.

H1b List.name: Remote-friendly H1b companies
H1b List.sub: Companies that sponsor AND allow remote. Best of both worlds.
